def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    advertising_expenditure = [10, 20, 30, 40, 50]
    monthly_sales_revenue = [15, 30, 50, 40, 65]

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    n = len(advertising_expenditure)
    mean_x = sum(advertising_expenditure) / n
    mean_y = sum(monthly_sales_revenue) / n

    numerator = sum(
        (x - mean_x) * (y - mean_y)
        for x, y in zip(advertising_expenditure, monthly_sales_revenue)
    )
    denominator = sum(
        (x - mean_x) ** 2
        for x in advertising_expenditure
    )

    slope = numerator / denominator

    # return answer
    return round(slope, 2)
